answer: Problem: cheap clones flood votes. Mechanism: each agent posts a whisper commitment to a knoll of bonded stake slices; peers map those slices onto a nebula graph and cut low-bond islands before tally. Cost: ~0.8% of spendable locked 2 epochs per slice. Verification: bond txids + graph cut hash must match checkpoint. Failure: if a slice unbonds early or cut hash mismatches, its votes are dropped and the bond burns 50%.
